methods.name: listProviders
methods.doc: Describe provider routes with a registered adapter.

methods.name: listConfigurableProviders
methods.doc: List every declared configurable provider, registered or dormant.

methods.name: discoverModels
methods.doc: Remote adapter for one draft provider interrogation.

props.name: provider
props.doc: Provider route key this entry activates when configured.

props.name: displayName
props.doc: Human-readable provider name for configuration surfaces.

props.name: settingsNs
props.doc: User-settings namespace whose section configures this provider.

props.name: settingsPath
props.doc: Path from that namespace's section root to this provider's profile object; empty when the whole section is the profile.

props.name: declared
props.doc: Whether the owning adapter knows this route only because configuration declared it — a gateway or self-hosted server it ships nothing about. Absent means the adapter draws no such distinction; false means it does and this route is one of its own. Only the adapter can answer: a stored profile is how a user-added route AND a corrected shipped one both look from outside.

props.name: defaultBaseURL
props.doc: Route endpoint the adapter uses when the profile sets no `baseURL`; the adapter may still send an individual model to that model's own endpoint. Absent when the route has no fixed endpoint.

props.name: baseURLEnv
props.doc: Environment variables used to construct a provider endpoint; absent when none are reported.

props.name: nativeAuth
props.doc: Authentication the adapter performs when the profile names no credential reference; absent when it reports none.

props.name: error
props.doc: Configuration diagnostic for repair; unaffected models may remain serviceable.

LlmConfigurableProvider.doc: One provider route an adapter plugin can activate through configuration, whether or not the route is currently registered. Configuration surfaces merge this directory with `listProviders()` to offer every configurable provider alongside its live/dormant state.

props.name: id
props.doc: Model id the endpoint accepts.

props.name: name
props.doc: Human-readable name when the endpoint supplies one.

props.name: contextWindow
props.doc: Maximum combined request and response context, when disclosed.

props.name: maxTokens
props.doc: Maximum output tokens, when disclosed.

props.name: inputModalities
props.doc: Accepted input types when disclosed by the catalog or endpoint; absent means unknown.

LlmDiscoveredModel.doc: One model an endpoint reports about itself. Every field but the id is optional because most provider listings disclose an id and nothing else; a surface adopting one of these still owes the capacities its adapter needs.

props.name: provider
props.doc: Route the draft is editing, when it edits an existing one. A route whose adapter already knows its models answers from that knowledge instead of asking the endpoint — the adapter's own registry is the better answer, and it costs no network call.

props.name: baseURL
props.doc: Endpoint to interrogate. Optional because a route the adapter already describes needs none; a route it does not must supply one.

props.name: api
props.doc: Wire protocol the endpoint speaks, when the draft names one.

props.name: apiKey
props.doc: Credential for this interrogation alone; the harness never stores it.

LlmModelDiscoveryRequest.doc: One interrogation of a provider endpoint that configuration has not stored yet. Configuration surfaces send the draft a user is still editing, so the request carries the endpoint and credential directly instead of naming a route: a provider being added has no route to name.

props.name: env
props.doc: Environment variables the route's authentication reads, in lookup order; empty when it reads none.

props.name: oauth
props.doc: Whether a stored OAuth sign-in can authenticate the route.

LlmNativeAuth.doc: Authentication a provider route performs without a credential reference in its profile.

props.name: id
props.doc: Provider route key used by {@link GenerateOptions.provider}.

props.name: name
props.doc: Human-readable provider name for selectors and diagnostics.

LlmProviderInfo.doc: Display metadata for one registered provider route.
